dimensions.detail: The documented capability matches the stated wellness purpose: it reads Zen+ notifications, timeline, catalogue, profile, and working-hours/preferences data. That data is mental-health-adjacent and personal, so it deserves care even though the API scopes are documented as read-only.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill has broad wellness triggers for stress, anxiety, relaxation, and self-care. That is coherent for a wellness catalogue, but users and agents should avoid fetching account-specific timeline, notification, or profile data unless the user clearly asks for Zen+ Health data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: A personal API key is proportionate for this integration, and the documentation repeatedly states read-only scopes and HTTPS use. Because the base URL is configurable, users should keep it pointed at the trusted Zen+ Health endpoint.

dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad stress and self-care triggers are real, but they align with a wellness skill and do not show hidden behavior or mutation. This supports privacy guidance rather than a Review verdict.
[SQP-2] expected: The skill can read sensitive wellness-adjacent profile, timeline, and notification data. That access is disclosed in SKILL.md and SECURITY.md and is read-only, but the agent instructions would be stronger with explicit confirmation before account-specific retrieval.
llm.guidance: Install only if you trust Zen+ Health and your OpenClaw environment with wellness notifications, timeline, profile, and preference data. Store ZEN_API_KEY as a secret, keep ZEN_API_BASE_URL set to the official Zen+ Health API host, avoid exposing responses in shared chats or logs, and revoke or rotate the key if it may have been exposed.
llm.summary: This is a disclosed read-only Zen+ Health integration, but it can expose sensitive wellness information if used in shared or poorly scoped environments.
